---
title: "TCGA Data Download from NCI's GDC Using TCGAbiolinks"
output: html_document
date: "2026-10-12"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

TCGAbiolinks Bioconductor package allows:
  - Open-source data retrieval from GDC
  - Data pre-processing
  - Standard analyses
  - Data visualization

Default data structure for downloaded RNA-seq data from GDC using TCGAbiolinks 
is a SummarizedExperiment object.

Required packages:
```{r}
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) BiocManager::install("TCGAbiolinks")
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) BiocManager::install("SummarizedExperiment")

suppressPackageStartupMessages(require(TCGAbiolinks))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(require(SummarizedExperiment))
```

Define TCGA project to download the associated data
```{r}
TCGA_project <- "TCGA-PAAD"
```

Download clinical information from the TCGA project
```{r}
clinical <- GDCquery_clinic(project = TCGA_project, type = "clinical") 
colnames(clinical)
```

Download RNA-seq processed data from normal samples
```{r}
query_normals <- GDCquery(
    project = TCGA_project,
    data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
    data.type = "Gene Expression Quantification", 
    workflow.type = "STAR - Counts",
    sample.type = "Solid Tissue Normal"
)
GDCdownload(query = query_normals)
rnaseq_normals <- GDCprepare(query = query_normals)
```

Download RNA-seq processed data from tumor (primary) samples
```{r}
query_tumors <- GDCquery(
    project = TCGA_project,
    data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
    data.type = "Gene Expression Quantification", 
    workflow.type = "STAR - Counts",
    sample.type = "Primary Tumor"
)
GDCdownload(query = query_tumors)
rnaseq_tumors <- GDCprepare(query = query_tumors)
```

Available assays in SummarizedExperiment: 
  - unstranded
  - stranded_first
  - stranded_second
  - tpm_unstrand
  - fpkm_unstrand
  - fpkm_uq_unstrand
  
```{r}
filename_normals <- paste0(TCGA_project, "_Normal_RNA-seq_RangedSummarizedExperiment.rds")
filename_tumors  <- paste0(TCGA_project, "_Tumor_RNA-seq_RangedSummarizedExperiment.rds")

saveRDS(rnaseq_normals, filename_normals)
saveRDS(rnaseq_tumors, filename_tumors)
```

```{r}
sessionInfo()
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), "session_info.txt")
```
